scope: Greece medical discovery — National and Kapodistrian University of Athens School of Medicine

institution.canonicalName: National and Kapodistrian University of Athens School of Medicine

verifiedFacts.claim: NKUA publishes 2026/27 tuition of EUR 17,000 for EU and non-EU Medical Degree English Program students, with a EUR 5,000 place-securement deposit and the balance paid in two instalments.

The current application process requires identity documents, secondary-school diploma and final-two-year transcripts, plus one accepted academic route such as IB, A-levels, UCAT, MCAT, AP/SAT, a cognate BSc or pre-med programme.
NKUA's current programme requirements give English thresholds including TOEFL 80/120 or IELTS 7.5 overall with at least 6.5 in each component.
The programme's official site confirms it is an international Medical Degree English Program of the NKUA School of Medicine and reports a completed 2026 academic year.

holdReasons: This batch did not establish independent, programme-specific current accreditation evidence required for the recognition badges; the programme's own statements about recognition are not sufficient by themselves.
No complete current source bundle was obtained for curriculum phases, named clinical partners/training arrangements, accommodation and practical student costs.
The admission requirements refer to current application materials, but a specific 2026/27 application deadline was not confirmed in the reviewed first-party sources.
nextAction: Obtain Hellenic quality/accreditation evidence for the English medical degree, a 2026/27 admissions calendar, and faculty documentation of clinical training and accommodation before packaging.
